transcript: If anyone doesn't like it, come text me. Did you know that in neuroscience we have something called brainwave synchronization? So EEG studies show that when we're in close proximity to our best friends, our neural pathways and our neurons oscillate at the same frequencies, especially in brain areas relating to empathy and emotion. So if you think that you and your best friend are on a wavelength, you quite literally are. And the closer you are to your best friend, the more that this is going to happen. Send us your best friend.
